description: Answers 'which US stocks were trading on this date - including ones that later delisted?' Give as_of (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today); optionally index top500/top1000/top3000 for the most-traded names priced at least $5 that day, prefix to filter, offset to page through 500 at a time. Returns the symbols trading that day across 16,000+ US stocks since 2000, delisted included. Free keys see the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).
